title: Faction cards in reaction buttons
description: Reaction offers for faction promissory notes, unit cards and leaders now show the printed card name and text instead of the engine id (for example "Play promissory:empyrean:iff:TURN_BEGAN:after"). Server games now also deal every seat its faction's real promissory notes, so these offers can occur. All shots are the real app against a mocked game.

shots.heading: Faction promissory note
shots.caption: The Creuss Iff held by another seat: the button reads "Use Creuss Iff" and the note's printed text sits beside it.

shots.heading: Generic promissory note
shots.caption: Ceasefire (every faction owns one) is named the same way.

shots.heading: Unit card ability
shots.caption: Duha Menaimon, the Arborec flagship, offered after its owner activates a system. Before: "Play unit:arborec:arborec_flagship:SYSTEM_ACTIVATED:after".

shots.heading: Leader ability
shots.caption: The Argent commander by name (Trrakan Aun Zulok) with its ability text. Before: "Play leader:argent:argentcommander:UNIT_ABILITY_ROLLED:when".

notes.title: Names come from the content catalog
notes.text: The button label is built from the option id (note alias, unit id or leader id) looked up in the generated content catalog; an id it does not know falls back to the humanized id.

notes.title: Notes in hands and trades
notes.text: Trades already printed note ids by name (Ceasefire (sol), Creuss Iff (ghost)); a test now checks that every faction note id in the catalog resolves.
